data.summary: Accomplished Treasury and Fund Accounting professional with over 12 years of expertise in Treasury Services, Global Cash Management, Fund Accounting, Securities Operations, and Payment Processing. Skilled in cash positioning, SWIFT MT/MX payments, FX settlements, reconciliations, operational risk management, and regulatory compliance across APAC, EMEA, and North America. Demonstrated success in leading cross-location teams, enhancing SLAs and reconciliation accuracy, strengthening internal controls, and driving operational efficiencies. Proficient in utilizing Bloomberg, Reuters, Oracle Flexcube, Aladdin, TLM, and Intellimatch to optimize financial processes and risk mitigation strategies.

raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Team Lead Account Manager – State Street Corporation
Jul 2022 - May 2026
Led an 18-member cross-location team delivering PAM Accounting transaction processing and middle-office services, ensuring
operational excellence.
Managed end-to-end processing of global securities transactions across Fixed Income, Equities, FX, and Money Market
instruments, ensuring timely trade execution, settlement, and accurate accounting.
Executed trade capture, validation, matching, settlement monitoring, and post-settlement activities in line with global market
practices and internal controls.
Processed payments via SWIFT (MT/MX), ensuring accurate and timely settlement of domestic and cross-border transactions
while maintaining high STP rates.
Monitored trade confirmations and settlement status across custodians, counterparties, and brokers to meet SLAs. Investigated and resolved failed trades, unmatched transactions, settlement breaks, cash exceptions, and payment
discrepancies by coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Performed daily cash positioning, cash reconciliation, nostro account reconciliation, and liquidity monitoring to ensure funding
availability.
Executed operational controls including reconciliation reviews, exception management, aging analysis, break resolution, and
risk & control reporting.
Collaborated with global teams across APAC, EMEA, and North America to resolve operational issues and improve
turnaround times.
Support NAV preparation in accordance with client requirements as well as implement incremental business and review NAV for
unit trusts and investment funds ensuring accuracy of valuation reports.
Worked with Bloomberg, Reuters, SWIFT, MCH, TLM/Reconciliation platforms, and internal banking applications to support
treasury and securities operations.
Coordinated with Investment Managers, Fund Administrators, Custodians, Middle Office Operations, and Accounting teams
to resolve outstanding breaks within agreed SLA timelines.
Reviewed NAV and valuation statements received from external fund administrators and investment managers and
investigate material differences against internal records.
Monitoring aged reconciliation breaks and maintain appropriate follow-up with responsible stakeholders to ensure timely closure. Supported month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities by completing outstanding reconciliations & providing
supporting schedules to the accounting and reporting teams.
Participated in process transitions, new fund onboarding, system implementation, UAT, and process improvement
initiatives.
Led aged-break management and escalation across alternative investment portfolios, driving timely resolution within agreed Consistently achieved high accuracy levels, reduced settlement exceptions, and contributed to continuous improvement
initiatives.
Team Lead 1 – Tata Consultancy Services
Mar 2021 - Jun 2022
Supported morning cash reporting and NAV inputs for Alternative Investments, performing variance analysis and break
investigations.
Communicated exceptions and risk items to stakeholders to enable timely resolution.
Team Lead 1 – Tata Consultancy Services
Oct 2018 - Feb 2021
Managed corporate account documentation and KYC processes for CitiBank UAE, including account openings, amendments,
authorized signatory changes, and customer maintenance requests.
Conducted client due diligence (CDD), AML screening, PEP verification, and risk assessments to ensure regulatory
compliance.
Coordinated with onshore and compliance teams to resolve documentation exceptions promptly.
Senior Process Associate – Tata Consultancy Services
Mar 2016 - Sep 2018
Investigated Nostro/Vostro and intercompany reconciliation discrepancies to ensure accurate financial reporting. Analyzed high-value multi-currency transactions to mitigate risk and ensure compliance. Processed SWIFT messages including MT103, MT202, MT199, MT299, MT940/MT950 to ensure timely and accurate
settlements.
Process Associate – Tata Consultancy Services
Mar 2013 - Feb 2016
Processed SWIFT payment investigations and resolved fund transfer queries for CitiBank. Investigated non-receipt of funds and identified payment exceptions to ensure accurate transaction processing.
Process Associate – Standard Chartered Scope International Private limited
Jun 2011 - Dec 2012
Processed individual and corporate KYC updates to ensure regulatory compliance. Supported RBI KYC remediation initiatives to enhance data accuracy and completeness. Contributed to compliance projects focused on regulatory adherence and risk mitigation.
State Street - PAM Accounting (APAC region)
46 Months
Led an 18-member cross-location team delivering PAM Accounting transaction processing and middle-office services for the
APAC region.
Morgan Stanley - Alternative Investment Banking Reconciliation
15 Months
Supported morning cash reporting and NAV inputs; led reconciliation processes for alternative investment portfolios to ensure
accurate daily NAV and managed futures NAV reconciliation.
Citibank - UAE Account Services Unit (UAE region)
28 Months
Led a team managing KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), and corporate account documentation processes for UAE clients,
improving operational efficiency and client satisfaction.
Citibank - Global Cash Management (EMEA region)
66 Months
Investigated and resolved SWIFT payment issues and fund transfer queries; performed Nostro/Vostro account analysis and
intercompany reconciliations to address breaks and discrepancies.
Standard Chartered - KYC - INDIA
18 Months
Conducted KYC document reviews, maintained customer records, streamlined KYC documentation processes, and
collaborated with teams to address compliance issues.
